Aggregate forecast draws over strata or ages

Source: R/hierarchy.R
mt_aggregate_draws.Rd

Computes draws for coarser groups from draws on the grid, path by path: over strata along a hierarchy (bottom-up: deaths are summed and divided by summed exposures) and over age groups (exposure-weighted mean rates).

Usage

mt_aggregate_draws(draws, hierarchy = NULL, age = NULL, exposure = NULL)

Arguments

draws

An mt_draws object.

hierarchy

Optional mt_hierarchy(); aggregate strata are added bottom-up from the bottom strata.

age

Optional coarser mt_axis (cells must nest).

exposure

Exposures [age, period, stratum] or [age, stratum] (default: last training year).

Value

An mt_draws object.

Examples

x <- mt_example(deaths = "single", years = 2000:2019)
fc <- mt_forecast(mt_fit(lee_carter(), x), h = 3, n_draws = 20, seed = 1)
fa <- mt_aggregate_draws(fc, hierarchy = mt_hierarchy(sex = "both"),
                         age = age_groups(c(30, seq(40, 100, 10))))
fa
#> <mt_draws> Lee-Carter; origin 2019; 8 ages x 3 periods (2020-2022) x 3 strata x 20 draws
